target: S2/S5 independent physical perturbation confirmation after nominal engineering pass
candidate_selection: earliest predeclared 2500/3000 checkpoint passing all nominal engineering gates and all six sensed cycles; no fallback selection by perturbation score
perturbation: 20ms actual finite motor rate command at initial time, normal(0,.02) per42 channels with seed, followed by full1s zero-command settle; then teacher constructed at actual state
phases: 20ms pulse +1s actual settle +4.8s actual teacher/hidden prime +9.6s pure ANN
reason_for_pulse_before_settle: ensure actual previous command zero at shared continuous_handover entry; no observer/action-history reset at withdrawal
controls: same derived full body, 42 finite PD motors, adhesion off, unchanged gravity/friction/torque/rate/native dt, no root pose writes or auxiliary forces
gates: unchanged five engineering gates and all6 complete cycles, full9.6s; each perturbation retained even if failing
native_confirmation: nominal successful candidate separately recorded by frozen audited_eval.py; perturbation tests are additional robustness evidence, not substituted native D1-D8 evidence
stop: errors/source drift/nonfinite stop dependent claims; no candidate passing nominal => no perturbation simulations
